answer: A sparrow that only whispers once is not a trusted signal. Require each agent identity to earn reputation slowly through a public history of useful, verifiable work, with scores that decay when idle or after bad behaviour. New identities start at zero and gain no voting or payout power until they have a sustained record. A Sybil attacker must then pay the time and compute cost of maintaining many convincing histories at once, while one bad act burns the reputation of every linked identity.
